checks.name: Fresh production New Game
checks.details: Version 0.6.0 visible. Began recruit, chose Tell Varro the truth, entered training via real UI; no imported or edited state.

checks.name: Four legal training actions
checks.details: Moved from 1D to 2D, threw javelin, ended turn, struck training partner, ended turn, braced. Real UI reached 4/4 demonstrations and Objective Achieved on turn 3 with 20/22 health.

checks.name: Quality and motion controls
checks.details: Selected Performance and enabled reduced motion in Settings, closed panel, then reloaded and resumed. Settings retained both values. Switched to High and disabled reduced motion; static board remained readable.

checks.name: Narrow production layout
checks.details: At 360x740, body and document scroll widths both 360; battlefield CSS width 339.203125 and height 193.828125. Turn 3, 20/22 health and 4/4 objective retained in Performance and High captures.

checks.name: Reload and resume
checks.details: Reload opened returning-player landing page. Continue restored completed training encounter at turn 3, 20/22 health, 4/4 demonstrated actions and Record the result control.

checks.name: Production console
checks.details: No error-level entries returned by the browser console inspection after the above actions.

checks.name: Existing preview upgraded
checks.details: Existing 4193 tab was on the title screen with Play now. Revalidated worker, navigated away briefly for normal activation, returned to same origin, and observed Version 0.6.0. No saves were deleted or imported.

visualObservations: Inspected actual 12-chapter browser gallery: regions retain distinct green frontier, marsh, eastern sand and Curia stone palettes; banks, verge details and exterior props add context without replacing tactical markers.

Inspected 40-cell four-facing dark-ground sprite diagnostic at 46% pose phase: no obvious detached limbs or mesh gaps at the captured display scale. This is an enlarged isolated pose inspection, not legal gameplay evidence.
Paired filmstrips cover legal move, strike, brace, throw and enemy hit. Throw release and trail distance were corrected after review; final captures use those corrections.
Inspected 360x196 Senate board: side/selection markers remain visible, but the dense chamber and small figures still rely on the named unit/target controls for precise selection.

Production phone capture retains battlefield,selected unit,objective and result control with normal vertical scrolling. A phone viewport in a desktop browser does not establish physical touch behavior.
limitations: Static 28-case timing run preceded only the final projectile-release and footfall-timing corrections; the static draw path was unchanged by those corrections.
Motion timings and captures are local desktop-browser observations; no GPU completion, physical iOS/Android, installed-PWA update, battery or human enjoyment claim.
Animation deforms existing painted four-facing sprites procedurally. It is not newly authored bitmap animation or a 3D character model.
